name: Metascript Rod, Persistent
body:
Aura strong (no design); CL 17th; Weight 5 lbs.; Price varies; 9,000 gp (lesser), 32,500 gp (normal), 73,000 gp (greater)

DESCRIPTION

The wielder can cast up to three scripts per day that are affected as though using the Persistent Script feat.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Feats Craft Rod, Persistent Script; Cost varies; 4,500 gp (lesser), 16,250 gp (normal), 36,500 gp (greater)
